Keep the new strong neon-chemical-GREEN, PURPLE and BROWN chemtech/chempunk identity, rich worn metal/stone materials, low frontal town-screen perspective and right-edge water access. CHANGE THE GROUND LAYOUT: remove the three straight rectangular raised platforms and the rigid parallel tier walls. Make one organically sloping industrial district ground plane with irregular modest level changes, short broken retaining sections and a few stairs only at edges. A worn curving central street should enter near bottomcenter and recede toward the uppermiddle, with asymmetric side lanes branching toward left and right. Natural streetside ground available for clustered buildings of different depths/sizes, no marked squares, no evenly spaced pads, no rigid rows or isometric grid. Perspective: near-ground texture and props larger, distant texture finer; buildings will later be separate sprites, larger in foreground and smaller fartheraway. Use nearly the entire width and lower85% ofcanvas as quiet unobstructed BUILDABLE terrain. Keep low atmospheric industrial canyon/gantries/cliffs along top15% and perimeter only, purple atmospheric depth with green chemical spill/inspectionwindows confined to those distant structures. Keep a narrow navigable canal on far RIGHT (roughly last8%ofwidth) and small dockable lower-right shoreline. Thread a few believable green reagent conduits along irregular gutters/perimeter walls, localized chemical green reflections in wet paving/water, occasional violet-glass accents. Strong chemtech identity is visible, not a barely colored grayscale street; brown brick/leather-like tarred timber/rust/ochre stone remain solid base, secondary amber heat only. Do not cover the building plots in luminous pipes, haze or debris.
KEEP EMPTY: do not draw functional houses, town halls, factories, towers, markets, tanks, giant foreground machines, interactable landmarks, people or creatures on any middle/foreground ground. Those are separate actual buildable layers added later. Do not bake a complete city into this background. No frames, text,labels,plots,UI. Late1990s originalHeroesIII painted/prerendered fantasy strategy texture, compactreadable masses, upperleft diffuse light and physical green localemission, atmosphericdepth. Notmodern glossy3D, neonvectoroutlines, flat greenfilter, sterile grid, isometricdiorama or photoreal road. Fullopaque edge-to-edge panorama, samewideframing; preserve functional open ground rather than a static fullybuilt scene.
